name: Vigorwasp Spray
description: Sprays vigorwasp mist that heals and revives hunters and Palico.
effect: Heals hunter and Palico. Can revive from cart via vigorwasp station. Scales with proficiency.
acquisition: Low Rank — Befriend the Bugtrappers in Ancient Forest (follow the trail of cats, complete Tailraider cultural quest "Befriending the Bugtrappers" HR 4). Speak to the Lynian at area 6 after gaining their trust.

name: Flashfly Cage
description: Caged Flashflies that stun monsters with a bright flash.
effect: Commands Flashflies to flash monsters, stunning flying monsters and interrupting attacks.
acquisition: High Rank — Upgrade from Bugtrappers proficiency 5+ or complete Gajalaka quest chain. Obtained after reaching Lv6 with Bugtrappers (share scoutfly data, complete 2★ "A Gajalaka Hunt").

name: Shieldspire
description: A shield decoy that taunts monsters, later summons Shieldspire Stooge.
effect: Taunts monsters and draws aggro. At proficiency 10 becomes Shieldspire Stooge that fights alongside you.
acquisition: Low Rank — Befriend the Protectors in Wildspire Waste (follow footprints near area 6, complete "Befriending the Protectors" HR 5).

name: Coral Orchestra
description: Plays coral horns that grant diverse buffs to the party.
effect: Randomly plays Defense Up, Attack Up, Status immunity, etc. Evolves to Coral Cheerbongo at max proficiency.
acquisition: Low Rank — Befriend the Troupers in Coral Highlands (complete "Befriending the Troupers" HR 7, escort the cats).

name: Plunderblade
description: Steals monster materials with every hit.
effect: Palico steals extra materials (shiny drops) from monsters. High chance on first hit, extra at proficiency thresholds.
acquisition: Low Rank — Befriend the Plunderers in Rotten Vale (complete "Befriending the Plunderers" HR 9, deliver raw meat to the Grimalkyne).

name: Meowlotov Cocktail
description: Tosses explosive cocktails that deal heavy elemental damage.
effect: Ranged explosive attacks. Upgrades add Gajalaka support calling.
acquisition: High Rank — Complete Gajalaka questline "The Gajalaka Way" after befriending 3 Grimalkyne tribes. Talk to Lynian Researcher in Elder's Recess, complete HR 12 "A Gajalaka-Hunting We Will Go".

name: Tailraider Signal
description: Call a friendly small or large monster to ride as a mount.
effect: Summons a Taillraider monster (up to 3 companions) to fight/ride. Hold interaction to mount and control. Signals available after befriending Boaboa.
acquisition: Master Rank — Iceborne. Befriend the Boaboa tribe in Hoarfrost Reach (complete MR "By Our Powers Combined" MR1, then quest "The Boaboa Way"). Reward from Boaboa chief after delivering pawswap items.

name: Meowcenary Safari
description: Dispatch Palico teams on resource gathering expeditions.
effect: Send safari teams (up to 1 per map, 4 total in Iceborne) to gather materials, monster parts and trade items while you hunt. Rewards scale with time and region state.
acquisition: Low Rank → Master Rank — Unlocks progressively: first safari via Housekeeper in Astera (HR 11, talk after finding first Grimalkyne). Iceborne adds Hoarfrost safari via Lynian Researcher MR 2 "Hunting Horn Harmony".
